import numpy as np
import networkx as nx

# Generate the fixed graph G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
np.random.seed(17)
G = nx.erdos_renyi_graph(200, 0.3, seed=17)

# Convert to adjacency matrix for faster computation
adj_matrix = nx.adjacency_matrix(G).toarray()

# Start with a random partition
np.random.seed(42)  # For reproducible starting point
partition = np.random.choice([0, 1], size=200)

# Greedy local search to improve the partition
def count_cut_edges(partition, adj_matrix):
    cut_count = 0
    n = len(partition)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            if adj_matrix[i][j] == 1 and partition[i] != partition[j]:
                cut_count += 1
    return cut_count

# Iteratively improve the partition
max_iterations = 1000
for iteration in range(max_iterations):
    current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj_matrix)
    best_improvement = 0
    best_vertex = -1
    
    # Try flipping each vertex
    for v in range(200):
        # Calculate change in cut if we flip vertex v
        change = 0
        for u in range(200):
            if u != v and adj_matrix[v][u] == 1:
                if partition[v] == partition[u]:  # Currently same side
                    change += 1  # Flipping v creates a cut edge
                else:  # Currently different sides
                    change -= 1  # Flipping v removes a cut edge
        
        if change > best_improvement:
            best_improvement = change
            best_vertex = v
    
    # If we found an improvement, make the move
    if best_improvement > 0:
        partition[best_vertex] = 1 - partition[best_vertex]
    else:
        break  # Local optimum reached

# Run multiple restarts with different initial partitions
best_partition = partition.copy()
best_cut = count_cut_edges(best_partition, adj_matrix)

for restart in range(10):
    np.random.seed(restart + 100)
    current_partition = np.random.choice([0, 1], size=200)
    
    # Local search from this starting point
    for iteration in range(500):
        best_improvement = 0
        best_vertex = -1
        
        for v in range(200):
            change = 0
            for u in range(200):
                if u != v and adj_matrix[v][u] == 1:
                    if current_partition[v] == current_partition[u]:
                        change += 1
                    else:
                        change -= 1
            
            if change > best_improvement:
                best_improvement = change
                best_vertex = v
        
        if best_improvement > 0:
            current_partition[best_vertex] = 1 - current_partition[best_vertex]
        else:
            break
    
    current_cut = count_cut_edges(current_partition, adj_matrix)
    if current_cut > best_cut:
        best_cut = current_cut
        best_partition = current_partition.copy()

import numpy as np
np.random.seed(17)

# Generate G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
n = 200
p = 0.3
edges = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))

# Create adjacency list
adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for u, v in edges:
    adj[u].append(v)
    adj[v].append(u)

# Start with random partition
np.random.seed(42)  # Different seed for initial partition
partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)

# Greedy local search
improved = True
while improved:
    improved = False
    for v in range(n):
        # Calculate change in cut if we flip vertex v
        current_cut_contribution = 0
        for neighbor in adj[v]:
            if partition[v] != partition[neighbor]:
                current_cut_contribution += 1
        
        new_cut_contribution = 0
        flipped_partition = 1 - partition[v]
        for neighbor in adj[v]:
            if flipped_partition != partition[neighbor]:
                new_cut_contribution += 1
        
        # If flipping improves the cut, do it
        if new_cut_contribution > current_cut_contribution:
            partition[v] = flipped_partition
            improved = True

import numpy as np

# Generate the fixed graph G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
np.random.seed(17)
n = 200
p = 0.3
adj_matrix = np.random.random((n, n)) < p
adj_matrix = np.triu(adj_matrix, 1)  # Upper triangular, no self-loops
adj_matrix = adj_matrix + adj_matrix.T  # Make symmetric

# Apply a greedy local search algorithm
partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)  # Random initial partition

def compute_cut_value(partition, adj_matrix):
    cut = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            if adj_matrix[i, j] and partition[i] != partition[j]:
                cut += 1
    return cut

# Local search: iteratively flip vertices that improve the cut
improved = True
while improved:
    improved = False
    current_cut = compute_cut_value(partition, adj_matrix)
    
    for v in range(n):
        # Try flipping vertex v
        partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
        new_cut = compute_cut_value(partition, adj_matrix)
        
        if new_cut > current_cut:
            # Keep the flip
            improved = True
            break
        else:
            # Revert the flip
            partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]

# Multiple random restarts to escape local optima
best_partition = partition.copy()
best_cut = compute_cut_value(best_partition, adj_matrix)

for restart in range(50):
    np.random.seed(17 + restart)
    test_partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)
    
    # Local search from this starting point
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        current_cut = compute_cut_value(test_partition, adj_matrix)
        
        for v in range(n):
            test_partition[v] = 1 - test_partition[v]
            new_cut = compute_cut_value(test_partition, adj_matrix)
            
            if new_cut > current_cut:
                improved = True
                break
            else:
                test_partition[v] = 1 - test_partition[v]
    
    final_cut = compute_cut_value(test_partition, adj_matrix)
    if final_cut > best_cut:
        best_cut = final_cut
        best_partition = test_partition.copy()
